name: Aenigmaspina
isnote: Described as an enigmatic pseudosuchian; PBDB lists Ornithosuchidae; check.
sum: Aenigmaspina is an enigmatic pseudosuchian archosaur from the Late Triassic of Wales, United Kingdom.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Fossils from a fissure fill near Pant-y-ffynnon, Wales (PBDB: unnamed unit, Carnian).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Patrick et al. 2019
